shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' ticket.md && sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short --branch && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md && printf '\\n--- dod ---\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '\\n--- relevant files ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && printf '\\n--- specs ---\\n' && rg -n -i 'inputSchema|schema|tool input|validate|undeclared|allowed' specs adrs 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
lore-query-trace --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,160p'
printf '\\n--- full registry tests ---\\n'
sed -n '1,340p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
printf '\\n--- tool validation spec ---\\n'
sed -n '1,300p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
printf '\\n--- package scripts ---\\n'
node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\"
printf '\\n--- ci failure markers ---\\n'
rg -n 'FAIL|Error:|registry\\.test|registry\\.acceptance|Test Suites|Tests:' ../round-brief.md | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "wc -l ../round-brief.md && sed -n '1,180p' ../round-brief.md && printf '\\n--- git history ---\\n' && git log --oneline -6 && printf '\\n--- trace executable search ---\\n' && (command -v lore-query-trace || true) && rg -l 'lore-query-trace|tests_covering' . ../ 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,80p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files scripts | rg 'spec.*(anchor|link)|reanchor' && rg -n 'function .*allowed|allowedValues|map\\(String\\)' src/orchestration/tools src | sed -n '1,120p' && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '20,110p'
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md | sed -n '8,30p'
sed -n '1,220p' scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'require-spec-link|validated by' eslint.config* scripts src | sed -n '1,180p'
sed -n '1,240p' eslint.config.js 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,240p' eslint.config.mjs 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs --fix && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs --fix && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --testNamePattern='"'^ToolRegistry validates a function definition against the schema resolved for each call$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "test tools dynamic schema validation" && git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && merge_status=$?; if [ "$merge_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$merge_status"; fi; if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then git push origin HEAD; fi; git status --short --branch'
